title: Classic Moai
body:
"Ooga ooga ooga chaga ooga ooga ooga chaga ooga ooga ooga chaga.. but retro.."

Description

The Classic Moai is a special item bought in the Classic Store for $1,250. It is part of the random rotation in the store.

Trivia

  • Moai but with a classic texture.
  • It has a small depression at the bottom.
  • The description appears to be a reference to the song Hooked On a Feeling.
